title: EU goes to Syria to talk business amid wider worries over lingering Russian influence and Jordanian attack
lede: The EU is spearheading efforts next week to get Syria back on its feet, followed by an investment conference in Jordan. But Russian influence and recent lethal Jordanian fighter-jet attacks in southern Syria point to lingering issues.

title: Europe’s youth take to the streets as the post‑war promise of a better life breaks down
lede: Europe's teenagers and students still believe in politics - but are turning away from parliaments and towards the streets. Hardly surprising, when the traditional milestones of adulthood – a degree, a stable job, a home and financial independence – are seem increasingly out of reach.
